summary: This note is a short biography of James Young, an American professional basketball player born August 16, 1995. It covers his final team, the Wisconsin Herd of the NBA G League, his single college season at Kentucky, and his 2014 NBA draft selection by the Boston Celtics. It also notes that he spent most of his rookie season with the Celtics' affiliate, the Maine Red Claws, in the NBA Development League.
one_line: James Young is an American basketball player drafted 17th overall by the Boston Celtics in 2014, after one season at Kentucky.
key_facts: James Young was born on August 16, 1995.
James Young is an American professional basketball player.
James Young last played for the Wisconsin Herd of the NBA G League.
James Young played one season of college basketball for the Kentucky Wildcats.
James Young was selected with the 17th overall pick in the 2014 NBA draft.
The Boston Celtics selected James Young in the 2014 NBA draft.
James Young spent the majority of his rookie NBA season playing in the NBA Development League.
James Young played in the NBA Development League for the Maine Red Claws during his rookie season.
The Maine Red Claws are the affiliate team of the Boston Celtics.
